rows.note: Use 圖標 as the everyday choice for a small computer or app symbol, rather than for a person or religious image.

example.english: This icon opens the app with one tap.
example.traditional: 呢個圖標一撳就可以開到個程式。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 tou4 biu1 jat1 gam6 zau6 ho2 ji5 hoi1 dou3 go3 cing4 sik1

rows.note: Use 偶像 as the all-purpose choice for a highly admired person who serves as a model or outstanding example.

example.english: They have always been an icon to me.
example.traditional: 佢一直都係我心目中嘅偶像。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 zik6 dou1 hai6 ngo5 sam1 muk6 zung1 ge3 ngau5 zoeng6

rows.note: Use 聖像 for a devotional religious image, including the Orthodox type, rather than for a secular role model or computer symbol.

example.english: The church has a religious icon on display.
example.traditional: 教堂入面供奉住一幅聖像。
example.jyutping: gaau3 tong4 jap6 min6 gung3 fung6 zyu6 jat1 fuk1 sing3 zoeng6
